questions.question: What should choosing a .blend file do to the open project?
Should .blend be offered for import only?
questions.assumed: Import only; export formats remain unchanged

questions.question: Which Blender objects should be appended?
questions.assumed: Mesh objects only; skip cameras, lights, empties and other datablocks with a warning

questions.question: Should appended meshes stay linked to the source file?
questions.assumed: No; append editable local objects and data

questions.question: Which parts of a multi-scene .blend should be imported?
questions.assumed: All mesh objects available in the file, once each

questions.question: How should .blend axes be interpreted?
questions.assumed: AUTO treats Blender files as Z-up; explicit axis overrides remain available

questions.question: Should scale and flatten options work for .blend?
questions.assumed: Yes, use the same scale and flatten behavior as other model imports

questions.question: What should happen if any part of a .blend import fails?
questions.assumed: Roll back every object created by that import and leave the prior scene untouched

questions.question: How should naming conflicts with existing objects be handled?
questions.assumed: Keep both and let Blender assign deterministic unique names

questions.question: What feedback should a larger import show?
questions.assumed: Keep the existing job feedback and report a clear completion or actionable failure

questions.question: May the live viewport simplify geometry while retaining the full model?
questions.assumed: Yes; simplify only the transmitted preview, never Blender state, saves or exports

questions.question: How much geometry should a settled live preview draw?
questions.assumed: Cap a full-scene preview at 40,000 triangles, preserving exact geometry below the cap

questions.question: What detail should be drawn while orbiting or zooming?
questions.assumed: Use at most 10,000 preview triangles during interaction, then restore the settled preview

questions.question: How should preview triangles be selected?
questions.assumed: Use deterministic evenly distributed sampling with compact remapped attributes

questions.question: How should a scene-wide preview budget be divided?
questions.assumed: Allocate proportionally while giving each visible mesh a fair minimum when possible

questions.question: Should users be told when the viewport is simplified?
questions.assumed: Yes; include truthful preview metadata and show a concise viewer notice

questions.question: Should an idle viewport render continuously?
questions.assumed: No; redraw only when scene, camera, selection, size, theme or texture state changes

questions.question: When should full preview detail return after movement?
questions.assumed: After a short 120 ms interaction-settle delay

questions.question: How should asynchronously loaded textures update an idle viewport?
questions.assumed: Texture completion explicitly invalidates and redraws the scene

questions.question: Should small models look exactly as before?
questions.assumed: Yes; no simplification under the preview budget

questions.question: Should .blend appear as an export choice?
questions.assumed: No; native Blender files are import-only in this feature

questions.question: Should the upload-size limit change for .blend?
questions.assumed: No; retain the existing 512 MB safety limit

questions.question: What should a corrupt or unreadable .blend produce?
questions.assumed: A named import error with the source path and no partial scene mutation

questions.question: What responsiveness should the semi-complex regression enforce?
questions.assumed: Camera input is accepted within 150 ms in the real-browser test fixture

questions.question: Should this feature replace the Canvas2D renderer with WebGL?
questions.assumed: No; optimize the current renderer and keep a GPU rewrite outside this scoped fix
